name: GAN Megaminx MagLev
description: The GAN Megaminx MagLev UV is a new puzzle from the famous manufacturer. This one has all kinds of upgrades! It has a MagLev mechanism that replaces the springs with opposing magnets. It has auto-aligning layers (up to 15 degrees) and uses the new GES Pro+ magnetization system. It also retains the concave shape to aid with grip and feel. This is an upgrade to an already highly-acclaimed megaminx. Get yours today!
